design.decision: Every trick becomes a puzzle about winning cheaply: ruff with the [2♠] instead of the [K♠], hold low cards of long suits for the end, and prefer Opening effects that keep cards low over ones that raise them.
design.opponent: Obvious after the first low win; opponents overruff low trumps, keep honors to beat late low cards, and avoid giving the team ruffing chances.
design.rationale: The Low Cards build-around: a repeated ×1.5 that compounds on two or three cheap wins (the legendary budget is ×2-×3 broadly). It changes how a whole run is drafted, toward low [♠]s, low-card rule benders, and away from raise effects, which is what a legendary should do.
design.draftText: ×1.5 contract multiplier when your team wins a trick with a [2] through [6]

critic.concerns: Clean legendary build-around; per-event compounding is hard to track.
